_ghi_chu: Antigravity doc cau hinh MCP tai:  ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json
(khong phai ~/.antigravity — day la cho de nham). Them khoi 'hardening' vao
trong 'mcpServers' co san, dung ghi de ca file.
Cung noi dung nay dung duoc cho Claude Code (~/.claude.json), Codex, Gemini CLI.
Server chi dung thu vien chuan Python — khong can pip install.
HARDENING_REPO          = repo mac dinh khi agent khong truyen tham so 'repo'.
HARDENING_ALLOWED_ROOTS = hang rao cung. Bo trong = cho phep moi noi (KHONG nen).
Nhieu duong dan cach nhau bang dau ':'.
PATH                    = BAT BUOC co ~/.cargo/bin. Antigravity khoi chay server
voi moi truong toi thieu, khong ke thua PATH cua shell,
nen thieu dong nay la server khong thay just/cargo.
